# Production-Ready E-Commerce Backend (Capstone)

## Objective
Build a complete API for storefront/mobile clients: catalog, auth, relational persistence, carts/orders, transactional stock, verified payment webhooks, controlled uploads, notifications, testing, security, observability and deployment.

## Assumptions and non-goals

## API contract and data model

## Local run/test commands

## Normal and failure-case evidence

## Security, logging, configuration and recovery

## Limitations / future work

required_features: Build a complete API for storefront/mobile clients: catalog, auth, relational persistence, carts/orders, transactional stock, verified payment webhooks, controlled uploads, notifications, testing, security, observability and deployment.
Document endpoint contracts and response status behavior.
Include automated tests for positive and negative cases.
Keep secrets out of source control and protect sensitive fields.
stretch_features: Add OpenAPI compatibility checks and migration validation.
Add measurable load/performance evaluation using synthetic data.
acceptance_criteria: Document requirements, resource models and endpoint contracts.
Include a reproducible starter or test plan with expected outputs.
Test one success path and one relevant failure/permission/edge case.
Record security, data-integrity, observability and deployment assumptions.
Separate completed tests from recommended but unrun tests.
test_plan: Create an isolated environment and configure non-production secrets.
Run automated unit/API tests from an empty or seeded test state.
Test invalid data, missing resources and authorization boundaries.
Test external services with mocks and controlled timeouts.
Review dependency updates, logs, health/readiness and cleanup/recovery.
review_method: Human review of implementation, reproducible test evidence, security assumptions, API contract and operational documentation. The course platform does not execute project code in the FastAPI production process.
status_note: Original project specification adapted from FastAPI.pdf Section D. It is a task brief, not an executed/certified reference implementation.
